name: I.D.I. Insurance Company Ltd.
summary: I.D.I. Insurance Company Ltd. provides insurance products and services to individuals and corporate customers in Israel. It operates through General Insurance, Health Insurance, and Life Insurance and Long-Term Savings segments. The company offers death, disability, accidental, and other insurance, as well as savings. It also provides insurance for medical expenses, personal accidents, serious illnesses, and travel. In addition, it offers vehicle liability and property insurance, as well as home and mortgage insurance. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Petah Tikva, Israel.
